LanguageData.ColonyManagerRedux.AutoSuspendPowerJobOn: Auto-suspend Power job on non-home maps

The Power manager job is created automatically on every map once Power Management is researched, including maps you're only visiting (quest sites, ambushes, etc.). With this setting enabled, it starts suspended (and silent) on non-home maps — you can un-suspend it manually from the Overview tab. Disable this if you want it to always start active, even on visited maps.
